description: This file defines the 'CalendarHistory' entity class, representing historical calendar data within the application. It includes fields for calendar details such as title, description, location, start/end dates, recurrence, and reminders, and methods to access and manipulate this data.

classes.name: CalendarHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing historical entries of calendar events, including details such as title, description, location, date range, recurrence, and reminders. It extends AbstractPersistableCustom with Long as ID type and provides methods for comparison and updating date fields.

methods.name: CalendarHistory
methods.description: Constructor initializing a CalendarHistory instance with associated calendar and start date, copying relevant details from the calendar object.

methods.name: getRecurrence
methods.description: Returns the recurrence pattern of the calendar history event.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the calendar history event.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the calendar history event.

methods.name: isStartDateBeforeOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the start date is before or equal to a given date.

methods.name: isEndDateAfterOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if the end date is after or equal to a given date.

methods.name: isBetweenStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the start and end dates of the event.

methods.name: updateEndDate
methods.description: Updates the end date of the calendar history entry.
